from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u092/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=program_dir/'task-1499e2ef.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    markers = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != background}
    marker = next(iter(markers))
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(len(row) - 2):
            if row[c] == marker and row[c + 2] == marker and row[c + 1] == background:
                out[r][c + 1] = 2
    return out
'''
